verdict.rationale: incident.io ships several AI features inside the product that generate suggestions from customer data. Suggestions drafts updates, summaries and follow-up actions from incident activity. Postmortem AI gives inline review suggestions. Investigations gathers evidence from telemetry, code and past incidents to form and test root-cause hypotheses. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and AI-generated insights over aggregate or historical data (the Insights dashboards are not documented as AI-driven).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.

The moment an incident is declared, an investigation gathers context from across your stack: the alert and its stack trace, similar past incidents, incident channel discussion and change events, your runbooks, recent code changes, and your telemetry.
It's a structured process that gathers evidence, forms a hypothesis, then tests that hypothesis against your code and telemetry, refining its conclusion as new evidence arrives.
